text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, that race was stunning!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro's halls are adorned with countless
victories—and I've finally
earned a plaque
of my own!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was not expecting such a resounding
display of joy from the
ever-demure
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear just how much the race meant to
her, and why she felt so
much pressure to
win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I apologize, I lost my composure. I do believe I've earned a bit of elation, however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In addition, I want to thank you for
helping me reach this result.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would dedicate all your
efforts just for me... I am
truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who should be doing all the
thanking. You placed all your
faith in a
newbie trainer like me, and delivered an
amazing win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...If I were to say that to her now,
though,
she would probably scold
me for a lack of
self-confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes. Let's continue to seize them
wherever the road may take
us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll go make the winning concert one
to remember. It's the least I
can do to
thank everyone who cheered me on!
